steps.title: DISCOVER
steps.body: Deep-diving into your goals, audience, and competitive landscape. Research, interviews, and synthesis — building the structural brief that guides every decision.

steps.body: Translating brief into blueprint. Wireframes, system design, information architecture, and tech stack decisions — before a single line of production code is written.

services.intro: A synthesis of technical precision and aesthetic rigour. I build digital structures that are not only functional but emotionally resonant — designed to scale with the speed of modern ambition.

items.body: Beyond mere templates — I construct bespoke visual identities. Focusing on the intersection of aesthetics and UX, every pixel is placed with structural intent, ensuring your brand commands attention through silence and sophistication.

Performance is the foundation of reliability. I engineer high-scale applications using modern frameworks that prioritise speed, security, and seamless integration. My approach treats code as a structural blueprint for business growth.

Harnessing the power of mobility with a native-first philosophy. I design and develop cross-platform solutions that feel indistinguishable from system software — ensuring maximum reach without compromising on fluid animations or performance.

I integrate large language models and AI agents directly into production software. From RAG pipelines to autonomous AI workflows, I build systems that are intelligent by design — not as an afterthought. Every AI feature I build is production-grade, observable, and built to last.

tiers.name: EMERGING
tiers.summary: Your organization is at the beginning stage of AI readiness. It's crucial to start building foundational capabilities: improve data quality, establish a clear AI strategy, and invest in basic tools.

tiers.name: DEVELOPING
tiers.summary: Your organization is in the development phase. You have some AI capabilities but need standardization and better integration. Focus on process optimization and employee training.

tiers.name: ESTABLISHED
tiers.summary: Your organization has a solid foundation for AI readiness. You have good data infrastructure and some AI applications. Now is the time to scale AI initiatives across the organization and focus on advanced use cases.

tiers.name: ADVANCED
tiers.summary: Your organization is at an advanced AI readiness level. You have mature AI capabilities and a data-driven culture. Focus on optimization, advanced AI applications, and continuous innovation.

tiers.name: TRANSFORMATIONAL
tiers.summary: Your organization is at a transformational level. You have fully integrated AI across all operations and are an industry leader in AI adoption. Continue innovating and share your experiences with other organizations.

privacy.heading: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.intro: This page explains what data this site collects, why, and how it's used. Written in plain language — not a legal template.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: The data controller for this site and its tools (AI ROI Calculator, AI Readiness Assessment, contact form) is Janar Kuusk, Tallinn, Estonia. For data questions, contact: info@janarkuuskpro.com.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Contact form: name, email, project type, and message you enter yourself. AI ROI Calculator and AI Readiness Assessment: the numbers and answers you enter to generate a result — these are sent to Google Gemini AI to produce the analysis. PDF report download: your email address, to unlock the report. We don't collect payment details or create user accounts.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: To respond to your messages and inquiries, to generate AI-based analysis from the data you enter, and (if you download a PDF report) to follow up about your project. We don't sell or share your data with third parties for marketing.

sections.title: Third parties
sections.body: We use the following processors: Formspree (contact form handling), Google Gemini API (AI analysis — your input text is sent to Google for processing), Google Firebase/Firestore (storing PDF report requests), Resend (optional email notification when a new request arrives), and Vercel (hosting). Each has its own privacy policy and data-processing terms.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.body: We keep contact-form and PDF-request data for as long as it's needed to respond to you, or until you ask us to delete it. There is currently no automatic deletion schedule.

sections.title: Your rights (GDPR)
sections.body: You have the right to request access to, correction of, deletion of, restriction on, and portability of your data, and to object to its processing. To exercise these rights, email: info@janarkuuskpro.com.

sections.title: Cookies & tracking
sections.body: This site currently uses no cookies or tracking tools (e.g. Google Analytics). If that changes, this page will be updated and a consent prompt added where required.

sections.title: International transfers
sections.body: Some of the providers we use (Google, Vercel) may process data outside the European Union. These providers apply safeguards for international transfers (e.g. the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses).

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be noted on this page.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about your data? Email: info@janarkuuskpro.com.
